summary: Frontend-only testing of CG Mushroom admin notifications feature. Admin login works. Sidebar nav 'Notifications' (data-testid admin-nav-notifications) present and routes to /admin/notifications. Page renders channel cards: notif-channel-email shows 'Live' with 'Sending as CG Mushroom', notif-channel-sms shows 'Not configured' with Twilio hint. notif-table lists 5 existing rows pre-change (2 sent, 2 queued, 1 failed as expected: admin alert to admin@cgmushroom.in failed with 422 'Recipient looks undeliverable', customer emails to delivered@resend.dev sent, SMS queued). All 4 filter buttons (all/sent/queued/failed) work with counts. notif-retry-btn fires POST /admin/notifications/retry and shows sonner toast 'Retried 3 pending notification(s)'. Hindi lang toggle (data-testid lang-toggle-hi) changes nav label to 'सूचनाएं' as expected. Changed CGM-1001 status Shipped→Delivered via order-status-select-CGM-1001 → order-status-option-delivered; refreshed notifications: 2 NEW 'Delivered' rows appeared — Email delivered@resend.dev=Sent ('Order delivered - CGM-1001'), SMS +919876543210=Queued (SMS not configured). All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminNotifications.js is concise, well-structured, uses data-testid everywhere, handles loading state via <Loading /> and errors via toast — good.

notifications.py (not re-reviewed in this iteration) correctly degrades: SMS without Twilio stays 'queued', admin email failure correctly surfaces as 'failed' with Resend 422 error. Retry endpoint re-tries only queued/failed as expected.
Minor: Table detail column truncates long error messages; title attribute provides full text on hover — acceptable UX.
seed_data_creation: No new orders created. Only changed status of existing CGM-1001 from Shipped to Delivered (as instructed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: CGM-1001 is now in 'delivered' terminal status. If future tests need status transitions, create a new COD order first. Lang toggle testids: lang-toggle-en / lang-toggle-hi (2 instances each: desktop sidebar + mobile header). Order status is a shadcn Select with triggers data-testid=order-status-select-{order_number} and options order-status-option-{status}.
